{{Short description|Canadian stock market index}} {{Infobox financial index | name = S&P/TSX Composite Index | logo = | image = S&P TSX Composite Index.png | caption = S&P/TSX Composite Index 1960–2012 | foundation = {{start date and age|2001|05|01}} after replacing the TSX300 which started in 1945 | operator = [[S&P Dow Jones Indices]] | exchanges = [[Toronto Stock Exchange]] | symbol = ^GSPTSE | constituents = 237 | cap_level = [[Large cap]] | mcap = | weighting = [[Price-weighted index]] | homepage = {{URL|https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/indices/equity/sp-tsx-composite-index/#overview}} }} The '''S&P/TSX Composite Index''' is the benchmark Canadian [[stock market index]] representing roughly 70% of the total [[market capitalization]] on the [[Toronto Stock Exchange]] (TSX). Having replaced the TSE 300 Composite Index on May 1, 2002,{{cite web |url=https://www.investmentexecutive.com/news/research-and-markets/tse-300-index-to-be-replaced/ |title=TSE 300 index to be replaced |date=January 30, 2002|access-date=November 14, 2023}} {{As of|2021|9|20|lc=y|df=US}}, the S&P/TSX Composite Index comprises 237 of the 3,451 companies listed on the TSX.{{cite web |url=https://investors.tmx.com/English/home/default.aspx|title=TMX Investor Relations |date=December 2022 |website=www.tmx.com|format=URL}} The index surpassed 30,000 points for the first time and reached an intraday high of 30,066 on September 23, 2025. ==Eligibility== [[File:TMXGroup3.JPG|thumb|TMX displaying S&P/TSX index information]] To be eligible for inclusion in the Composite Index:[[Wikinvest:S&P/TSX Composite Index (.TTT-T)|TSX methodology via Wikinvest]] * '''Market capitalization:''' For eligibility any security must represent a minimum weight of 0.05% of the index. Moreover, the security must have a minimum weighted average price of at least C$1 over the past three months and over the last three trading days of the month-end prior to the exchange reviewing the index. * '''Liquidity:''' The trading volume in terms of dollar value and the number of transactions must exceed at least 0.025% of the sum of all eligible securities' trading volume. To ensure that no single company dominates trading, they are capped at a maximum of 15% for value, volume and transactions. * '''Domicile:''' Stocks must be listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and be incorporated under Canadian laws. == Record values == {| class="wikitable" ! extract: The S&P/TSX Composite Index is the benchmark Canadian stock market index representing roughly 70% of the total market capitalization on the Toronto Stock Exchange (TSX). Having replaced the TSE 300 Composite Index on May 1, 2002, as of September 20, 2021, the S&P/TSX Composite Index comprises 237 of the 3,451 companies listed on the TSX. The index surpassed 30,000 points for the first time and reached an intraday high of 30,066 on September 23, 2025.
